name: Whose Eyes?
description: The class names everyone your topic touches, then each student steps inside a DIFFERENT classmate's suggestion and speaks from that viewpoint, 30 perspectives instead of the 5 a discussion gets. No scores.
tagline: Perfect for a historical decision, a science dilemma, a novel's turning point, or a school policy.

topic.label: The topic
topic.helper: Anything with more than one side: 'the Louisiana Purchase', 'building the new dam', 'chapter 12 of Holes', 'our school's homework policy'.
topic.deckHelper: Pick a topic with many stakeholders, or bring your own.

writeTime.label: Writing time (seconds)
writeTime.helper: How long students get to write from their assigned viewpoint.

template.name: Whose Eyes?
template.description: A perspective circle built with the Whose Eyes? recipe: the class generates the viewpoints, then everyone speaks from a classmate's suggestion.

viewpoints.prompt: Name ONE person, creature, or thing affected by: ${topic}. Anyone whose eyes we could look through.

fields.label: From this viewpoint, I worry about or hope for...
A question I have, from here...

circle.message: The circle of voices, one pair of eyes at a time.

end.message: That's the circle, and the question column is tomorrow's lesson.
